title: Family Picnic with Baby on Grass, 1949 B&W Vintage Photo Snapshot
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot taken on July 31, 1949, capturing a relaxed summer picnic in a public park. In the foreground, a young woman in a classic 1940s swimsuit lies reclining on a dark blanket on the grass, holding hands with an upright baby sitting nearby in a diaper shirt. Another young woman sits beside them while park foliage, a outdoor grill, and distant parkgoers populate the background, exemplifying post-World War II American family leisure culture.
